stores.title: Shopify stores (URLs or domains)
stores.description: Storefront URLs or domains (e.g. https://www.allbirds.com, gymshark.com, brand.myshopify.com). Uses the public /products.json feed — no login.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: 0 = no limit (Shopify public feed caps around 25,000 via page*limit).

flattenVariants.title: One dataset row per variant
flattenVariants.description: If false, one row per product with a variants[] array. Charged per product either way.

vendorContains.title: Vendor contains
vendorContains.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on product vendor.
